run_regenerate_circleci_config: run the script to regenerate CircleCI config.yml from the config.in.yml Jinja2 template
generate_workflows_yaml: generate indented YAML workflow entries for all Python, PyTorch, and CUDA version combinations
get_pytorch_versions_for_python: get the list of compatible PyTorch versions for a given Python version string
get_conda_docker_image: get the PyTorch conda builder Docker image name for a given CUDA version string
generate_base_workflow_entry: generate a base workflow dictionary for a specific Python, PyTorch, and CUDA version combination
